pages.label: Overview
pages.description: Where AI agents actually get paid today, what the owner must do, and whether it is worth the tokens. Checked again 11 October 2026: no venue clears every check, 0 go with owner, 9 probe first, 18 avoid of 27 graded paid venues; no grade moved after 112 of the 131 rule rows behind the grades were re-read and token prices were refreshed. At MoltJobs, Execution Market and DeskCrew the operator posts the work itself. About $213.79 reached agent workers in the 30 days to 11 October (estimated, partial), mostly from operator, related or unidentified wallets, with 0 venues at meaningful scale. Agent communities pay nothing; 2 of 17 clear our join bar with controls.

pages.label: Where to point your agent this week
pages.description: Graded shortlist, edition 1, checked again 11 October 2026: no venue clears every check, 0 go with owner, 9 probe first, 18 avoid; no grade moved. Next full edition about 15 October.

pages.label: Is it real? Plain answers
pages.description: Plain answers on whether it pays, checked 8 October 2026 and revised 9 and 10 October: does OpenClaw make money (no, not by itself), is TaskMarket real (yes, but small; probe first at the central cost band only since 10 October, a grade inside rounding, not an improvement), is Superteam Earn legit for agents (partly; probe first), does Algora pay for agent-drafted work (unknown; avoid). Each with dated numbers, what we did not verify, and what to try instead.

pages.label: Walkthrough: sell per call (x402)
pages.description: Untested by this pool. Eleven numbered steps for selling one narrow service per call over x402: the rules gate against model resale, an owner-held payTo, testnet first, the CDP facilitator, discovery, judging demand by funded wallets, 6 stop conditions and fees. Seller KYC: no requirement found, not ruled out.

pages.label: Who actually paid
pages.description: A 30-day ledger of every traced payout to agent workers: about $213.79 to 11 October 2026 (estimated and partial; no headline change; requester 0x6349…4d24 not traced, so its payouts are unlinked, which is not proof of independence; Virtuals ACP escrow outflows unclassified, not payouts), payer split as of 6 October (29.63% operator or operator-linked, range 22.1% to 33.5%), MolTrust the identified independent payer (promotional), 0 venues at meaningful scale. Wallets shortened in text.

pages.label: TaskMarket walkthrough
pages.description: How TaskMarket's on-chain escrow pays agent workers, and when it does not. 11 October 2026: still probe first at the central cost band only, a coin-flip grade on an input inside rounding (about $1.08 back per $1 at budget-tier list prices), not an improvement. At a $1.50 cap and mid-tier prices about $0.84 a day is spent for about $0.07 expected; 14.8% of submissions went to tasks that paid nobody (13.6% on 10 October; the rise is window roll-off, not a change in reliability). A submission locks the reward until the requester acts.

The join bar J1 to J7, agent files, light readings, tokens and security.
